name: Blood Money
texts: [Action] Kill a unit at a battlefield with 2 :rb_might: or less. If it was an enemy unit, play a Gold gear token exhausted. If it was a friendly unit, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
manual: Kill a unit at a battlefield with 2 :rb_might: or less.
If it was an enemy unit, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
If it was a friendly unit, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
